jobs.title: Head of Financial Systems Transformation
jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:  

Taxfix is going AI-first with full speed - and Finance at Taxfix is leading by example: We are looking for an expert professional who will be leading both the transformation of financial processes and implementation of AI in the Taxfix financial systems infrastructure. The focus is on improving our core operational finance processes further through automation and best-in-class practices - and to keep evolving them as AI reshapes what's possible both inside and outside our company and its AI-native platform.

This role demands subject matter expertise in finance, technology, and leadership across dialogues with senior leaders, product and technology experts, as well as incumbent finance team to ensure both planning and implementing of the financial systems infrastructure roadmap over time while ensuring resilience, compliance, cost effectiveness, and scalability.

Your impact will be visible across the firm including the most senior stakeholders. You'll define and own the roadmap end-to-end, from architecture decisions and change, to hands-on ERP configurations and design decisions, on to bespoke additions and refinements to all financial systems, while further embedding automation and AI into how financial systems and the Finance team operate at Taxfix. As part of this transformation you will lead a dedicated and highly motivated team.

This is in essence an architectural role where you are the finance team’s anchor co-evolving the a financial system total that meets growth in product complexity, R&D and infrastructure development, as well as strategic ambition. As such, the ability to sketch out a finance roadmap and implementation game-plan amidst such strategic context and growth ambition is key. This is paired with senior stakeholder management and delivering implementable projects with the day-to-day team.

The ideal candidate has a double spike amidst this context: historically a finance professional by training and with first-hand expertise across all core finance processes (order-to-cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay), followed by years of hands-on finance systems work, automation and ERP experience blending more recently into AI, advanced analytics, business process workflows, and finance transformation projects. Your accounting literacy and sensitivity for audit-ready data and systems are matched by your technical depth.

the “other way round” works just as well: a data engineer or leader with a more technological background by training, historically, to meanwhile having transitioned into complex business and finance projects. As such, core finance processes including treasury and financial planning systems with reconciliation procedures are ingrained in your way of thinking and working, and by now you have been responsible for financial systems for years in your current role. You have been delivering results across financial system builds utilizing Precoro, Netsuite, Pigment, Chargebee and Abillify or similar, as well as driven wider best practices across accounting and treasury system transformations, all of which are complemented by more advanced developments of the last 2-3 years around AI workflows, vibe coding, business process and systems transformation put to work.

All of these render you a “builder” of the near future at Taxfix: a leader across topic and strategic dialogues for finance with company leadership internally and with strategic partners delivering financial technology to Taxfix externally.

Your responsibilities:

  • Map the current finance systems landscape across all Taxfix countries, identify improvement areas, and design the target architecture - owning integration patterns, data flows, and system boundaries across the full stack

  • Drive the transformation of core finance processes through AI & automation and integration of best-in-class tooling across our systems spanning revenue recognition, accounting, treasury, and billing - from vendor selection through to go-live

  • Make AI-powered automation a first-order priority, identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the controllership, and build up integrated core workflows - all of it not as an afterthought

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and finance technology to ensure we're always running the best systems available - and staying at the forefront of technology and efficiency

  • Define and sequence the multi-year finance transformation roadmap, balancing strategic ambition with pragmatic delivery, resilience, scalability and cost effectiveness when driving system design decisions and strategy

  • Build a systems architecture that meets institutional-grade standards: robust controls, clean audit trails, and access governance expected of a mature, regulated business while navigating resource allocation for finance systems, source of truth data model, reconciliation paths, API connectivities, all of which in an international setting

  • Co-own the control layers across finance systems incl. month-end close, revenue recognition, and multiple KPIs across all core finance processes

  • Act as the primary liaison between Finance, Engineering, Product, and external partners - translating finance requirements into technical reality

  • Lead system oversight and control across finance systems and strategically govern and document key processes - in particular monthly closing and chargebacks

  • Ensure our client solutions and ecosystem of products are continuously supported by a financial infrastructure that can be considered best in-class with built-in audit readiness

Your profile:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience spanning finance operations and finance systems such as billing platforms or payments infrastructure, with deep ERP implementation and change expertise, and proven ownership of technological systems across high-stakes, time-sensitive change projects and workflow automation in multi-entity environments

  • Proven experience integrating, migrating or upgrading ERP platforms with multiple vendors and strategic partners, e.g. with focus on subscription systems - you understand order-to-cash and revenue recognition at a system level, not just conceptually

  • Track record owning AP/AR automation and treasury system implementations, including integration design

  • Genuine fluency with AI in a finance context - you know how to separate hype from leverage and have built automation that stood the test of time

  • Strong controllership knowledge across accounting close, consolidation, VAT, inter-company, and cash management

  • Familiarity with governance and controls landscape, audit readiness and reporting standards of a scaled, institutionally mature organization

  • Builder's instinct: you see fragility in a process and feel compelled to fix it - with systems, automation, or both

  • Professional technical qualifications matter (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent standards in finance - or engineering); strong practical experience and demonstrated results delivery carry equal weight

Why this role?

  • You'll own the full transformation arc - from assessing best-in-class against company requirements, designing and planning implementation projects and thereby continuously evolving finance in an AI-driven world where automation handles the repetitive work and every core process runs on best-in-class tooling. If that's the kind of work that gets you out of bed, let's talk.


Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

jobs.title: FinCrime AML/CTF Specialist
jobs.description:
Please note that this job requires mandatory relocation to Luxembourg.

About us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What you'll be doing

As our FinCrime AML/CTF Specialist, you’ll be the person who applies expert investigative methodology to resolve high-risk compliance matters, ensuring Satispay’s integrity in an evolving regulatory landscape. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • Detection & Trend Analysis – Managing Transaction Monitoring (TM) workflows focused on AML typologies, proactively identifying emerging trends, and spearheading the creation of new alerting systems and detection rules to improve overall network security.

  • Advanced Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) – Leading deep-dive reviews of high-risk accounts, complex entity ownership structures, and jurisdictional risks.

  • Specialized Investigations – Conducting thorough Source of Funds (SoF) and Source of Wealth (SoW) investigations, verifying legitimacy through rigorous documentation and data analysis.

  • High-Stakes Disposition – Performing expert disposition on complex Name Screening alerts (e.g., sanction/PEP hits) that require detailed risk assessment and defensible rationales.

  • Regulatory Reporting – Consistently preparing, drafting, and finalizing high-quality Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) for Fraud and AML-centric cases.

  • Technical Escalation Management – Acting as the primary resource for resolving AML-centric escalations from the wider Monitoring team.

  • Policy & Intelligence – Supporting the optimization of the AML/CTF policy framework by translating regulatory updates into operational processes and analyzing high-risk typologies to sharpen our controls.

  • Stakeholder Liaison – Serving as a key contact for internal Legal and Compliance teams and supporting Quality Assurance (QA) reviews for high-risk case dispositions.

Who we're looking for

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you?

  • Experience – You bring 3+ years of experience in a first-line AML operations or specialized compliance role, with proven experience in handling complex entity structures and turning regulatory requirements into actionable procedures.

  • Regulatory-to-Operational Expertise – An expert understanding of AML Directives, FATF recommendations, and local Luxembourgish AML laws, paired with the ability to operationalize these mandates into detection systems and risk workflows.

  • Analytical Prowess – Superior critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex, disparate data from internal and external sources (OSINT, company registers, etc.) into actionable conclusions and improved alerting logic.

  • Reporting Excellence – Exceptional written communication skills for drafting detailed, defensible regulatory reports that clearly articulate the operational risk.

  • Technical Skills – Proficiency in utilizing external screening databases (e.g., ComplianceAssist) and a deep understanding of how to leverage TM systems and data tools to detect sophisticated typologies.

  • AML Typology & Flow Mastery – The ability to navigate the highest levels of complexity with full autonomy, identifying hidden risks and designing the flows needed to mitigate them.

  • Strategic Risk Communication – The ability to act as the definitive voice on AML risks, providing the technical and operational guidance needed to address emerging threats.

jobs.title: Senior Go Backend Developer (Catalog) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive

The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With over 200 million monthly visits, there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.

The system runs on AWS Spot Instances spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user. Backed by Kubernetes with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at 200 million monthly visits. The frontend is built on React and Vite, leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second. On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run A/B experiments per more than 2000 games on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • Production Golang Systems Expertise: You bring 5+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years writing Go in production distributed environments. You will build and maintain our +99% Go microservice architecture—interfacing with our TypeScript/React frontend—to reliably handle 2+ million daily publisher interactions and scale beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming: You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • High-Scale Data & API Optimization: You understand database internals and low-level web standards (HTTP protocol, Encoding, Regular Expressions). You will optimize queries across hundreds of terabytes of data across DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena to reduce API response times and expose transparent, well-documented open APIs to enterprise partners.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration: You quickly grasp complex technical topics and applied mathematics. You will partner directly with our Data Science team to translate and integrate machine learning algorithms into adjoe’s core application, optimizing real-time ad targeting.

  • Collaborative Technical Communication: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You will actively participate in peer code reviews and technical knowledge sharing across an international backend engineering team.

  • Plus: Infrastructure & Cloud Tooling: Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), Docker containerization, or serverless infrastructure.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics

  • Making a minimum number of quality outbound calls per day

  • Become a mentor to new hires entering into the Business Development organization

  • Become a key stakeholder in Zip’s growth as we continue to scale our core business

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Accounting, Rechnungswesen oder Steuern. Eine Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) ist von großem Vorteil, aber kein Muss.

  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit, Genauigkeit und Hands on Mentalität sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln. 

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie Motivation, sich fachlich und perspektivisch weiterzuentwickeln. 

Nice to haves: Jedes zusätzliche Know how ist ein Pluspunkt

  • Erfahrung aus Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Beratung, beispielsweise aus dem Big Four Umfeld

jobs.title: Senior Creative Digital Strategist (m/w/d) in Stuttgart - Hybrid
jobs.description:
Ihre Aufgaben

Entwickle Ideen, die Marken verändern.
Die besten Strategien entstehen nicht in endlosen Präsentationen.
Sie entstehen dort, wo Menschen neugierig bleiben, Daten hinterfragen, kreative Ideen zulassen und den Mut haben, Dinge anders zu denken.
Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Als Senior Creative Digital Strategist entwickelst du nicht einfach Marketingkonzepte. Du schaffst Strategien, die Unternehmen dabei helfen, sichtbar zu wachsen, Marken zu schärfen und Menschen nachhaltig zu erreichen.
Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie, Kreation und Performance – gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams und spannenden Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen.
Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, Herausforderungen liebst und deine Ideen echte Wirkung entfalten sollen, dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist
Marketing verändert sich schneller als je zuvor.
Neue Plattformen entstehen. Zielgruppen verändern ihr Verhalten. Künstliche Intelligenz verändert Prozesse und Content. Unternehmen brauchen heute keine isolierten Maßnahmen mehr. Sie brauchen Menschen, die Zusammenhänge erkennen. Menschen, die kreative Ideen entwickeln, strategisch denken und digitale Möglichkeiten sinnvoll miteinander verbinden.
Genau diese Rolle übernimmst du bei uns.

Deine Mission
Du hilfst unseren Kund:innen dabei, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Nicht durch Bauchgefühl. Sondern durch Strategie.
Du entwickelst Konzepte, die Kreativität, Technologie und Daten intelligent miteinander verbinden und übersetzt komplexe Herausforderungen in verständliche Handlungsempfehlungen.

Deine Aufgaben
Strategische Beratung
Du begleitest Unternehmen bei ihrer digitalen Kommunikation und entwickelst kanalübergreifende Strategien mit messbarem Mehrwert. Dabei verstehst du sowohl die Unternehmensziele als auch die Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen.

Creative Strategy
Du entwickelst Leitideen, Kampagnenansätze, Kommunikationskonzepte und Content-Strategien, die Marken differenzieren und langfristig funktionieren.
Du formulierst Creative Briefings, die unseren Kreativteams Orientierung geben und aus guten Ideen starke Kampagnen machen.

Workshops & Sparring
Du moderierst Workshops, führst Interviews, hinterfragst bestehende Denkweisen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen neue Perspektiven.
Dabei trittst du als strategischer Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe auf.

Markt & Insights
Du beobachtest Trends, analysierst Märkte und Wettbewerber und leitest daraus Chancen für unsere Kund:innen ab. Du erkennst Entwicklungen frühzeitig und machst sie nutzbar.

Präsentation & Storytelling
Komplexe Themen einfach erklären gehört zu deinen Stärken.
Du präsentierst Strategien überzeugend – intern wie extern – und schaffst es, Menschen für deine Ideen zu begeistern.

Zusammenarbeit
Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen aus Performance Marketing, SEO, Social Media, Design, Redaktion und Projektmanagement zusammen. Du verstehst Strategie als Teamsport.


Anforderungen

Dein Profil:Must-Have:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Grafikdesign, Mediengestaltung, Digitales Marketing oder vergleichbare Ausbildung.
  • 2 - 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der digitalen Content-Produktion und Kampagnenentwicklung.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) und auch Canva und KI Tools
  • Erfahrung in der Videoproduktion und -bearbeitung sowie der Erstellung von Motion Graphics.
  • Vertraut mit Plattformen wie Meta Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn und YouTube.
  • Kreativität, ein gutes Auge für Design und Animation sowie eine hohe Detailorientierung.
  • Fließend Deutsch und gerne auch in Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
Nice-to-Have:
  • Kenntnisse in 3D-Design und Animationstools (z. B. Blender, Cinema 4D).
  • Erfahrung mit dynamischen Werbeanzeigen (z. B. Programmatic Creatives).
  • Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-gestützten Kreativ-Tools (z. B. MidJourney, DALL-E, Runway).
Erfolgskriterien:
  • Hohe Qualität und Termintreue bei der Erstellung digitaler Kampagneninhalte.
  • Zufriedenheit der internen Stakeholder durch Flexibilität und schnelle Umsetzung.
  • Positive KPI-Entwicklung durch datenbasierte Optimierung von Creatives.
  • Integration neuer kreativer Ansätze und Tools zur Verbesserung der Kampagnenperformance.
Das bringst du mit
Du musst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllen. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Idealerweise verfügst du über:
  • mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Agentur oder im strategischen Marketing
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Kommunikationsstrategien
  • Ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken und Zielgruppen
  • Analytisches Denken kombiniert mit Kreativität
  • Erfahrung in Workshops und Kundenpräsentationen
  • Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Entscheider:innen
  • Begeisterung für digitale Trends und Innovationen
  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Workflows, Employer Branding oder B2B-Kommunikation ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss.
So arbeiten wir
Wir glauben an Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement.
An ehrliches Feedback statt Hierarchiedenken.
An Zusammenarbeit statt Silodenken.

Bei den KlickPiloten bekommst du Raum, Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Wir möchten nicht, dass Menschen einfach Aufgaben abarbeiten. Wir möchten, dass sie unsere Agentur aktiv mitgestalten.


Kontaktinformationen

Das erwartet dich
Neben flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen und modernen Benefits bieten wir dir vor allem eines:
Ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen gehört werden.

Außerdem erwarten dich:

  • Hybride Arbeitsmodelle
  • Moderne Hardware
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsbudgets
  • Urban Sports Club oder Wellpass
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Interdisziplinäre Projektteams
  • Abwechslungsreiche nationale und internationale Kunden
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum
Bewerbungsprozess
Wenn du Performance und Kreativität verbinden, AI-gestützte Produktionsprozesse aktiv mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit uns den Creative-Bereich auf das nächste Level bringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Zeig uns in deinem Portfolio oder Vorstellungsvideo nicht nur starke Designs, sondern auch deine konzeptionelle Denkweise, AI-Kompetenz und Beispiele für performante Kampagnen.

Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack (International)
Director, UK Enterprise Sales (Retail)

Member of Product Staff, Engineer (London)
jobs.description:
Coding was first. Recruiting is next — and we're building it.

We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end recruiting agents that feel like coworkers. Metaview helps organizations hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate toil and augment humans for teams like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

Founded by Siadhal Magos and Shahriar Tajbakhsh, who scaled Uber and Palantir, we have raised over $50M from top-tier investors. We are growing 5x year over year, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times.

Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We are looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

We have one value: velocity.
Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. We barely write code by hand anymore: every engineer orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short.

What you'll build
Day to day, you'll work on:

  • new product experiences across the hiring workflow

  • systems that turn conversational signal into structured actions and insights

  • AI-assisted features that need to feel useful, transparent, and well-integrated into the product

  • improvements to quality, speed, and reliability across both user-facing and agent-facing parts of the product

  • product problems that cut across engineering, design, product, and go-to-market context

What you'll own

In your first 3-6 months, you should:

  • own and ship meaningful product areas from problem definition through rollout

  • help shape how Metaview's AI products behave in real customer workflows

  • identify and drive improvements that make the product faster, clearer, and more valuable

  • contribute to the engineering bar across craft, execution, and product judgment

What we're after

We're hiring across all levels, but we are excited by people who:

  • have shipped product in fast-moving software environments

  • are comfortable working across the stack, or moving outside their default lane when needed

  • care deeply about users and can translate messy problems into clear product decisions

  • combine technical strength with product sense and good judgment

  • like ownership, ambiguity, and close collaboration across functions

  • want to help build a category-defining product while the shape of the company is still being formed

What you bring

Helpful signals include experience with:

  • shipping products, workflow software, or AI-enabled products

  • systems where frontend and backend decisions meaningfully shape each other

  • building products used in consequential or trust-sensitive moments

  • startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high

What you want to know

  • A small, sharp, in-person team in London. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook.

  • We pay in the top 10% of the market — salary and meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct. It's not unusual to hear back the same day.

  • We operate with a simplified leveling, early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games. We track the market closely and adjust when it tells us to. Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market two times a year and move comp up when it drifts — so "top 10%" stays true, not just true on your start date.

  • Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. It's tied to a real change in the work rather than an automatic bump.

  • Equity that's genuinely competitive. World-class equity option grants so we’re all owners. We keep the structure simple: cash and equity.

  • Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish.

  • Time off, unlimited. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance (UK)
jobs.description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

jobs.title: Working Student Field Marketing and Events DACH (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

Du möchtest erleben, wie modernes B2B-Marketing wirklich funktioniert – dort, wo Kampagnen entstehen und Events zum Leben erweckt werden? Dann werde Werkstudent:in im Bereich Field Marketing & Events DACH bei der EQS Group und unterstütze unser Team dabei, Kampagnen, Veranstaltungen und Partnerschaften umzusetzen, mit denen wir unsere Zielgruppen erreichen.

Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Marketingkolleg:innen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz zusammen, unterstützt uns bei spannenden Veranstaltungen in der gesamten DACH-Region und lernst von Anfang an, wie moderne KI-Tools dabei helfen, Marketing effizienter zu gestalten. Wenn du neugierig bist, strukturiert arbeitest und dich fachlich schnell weiterentwickeln möchtest, bietet dir diese Position den idealen Einstieg.

Die EQS Group ist ein führender internationaler Cloudsoftware-Anbieter in den Bereichen Compliance & Ethics, Data Privacy, Sustainability Management und Investor Relations. Wir unterstützen Tausende von Organisationen weltweit dabei, die Herausforderungen moderner Unternehmensverantwortung zu meistern. Unsere Lösungen helfen Unternehmen, Daten zu schützen, regulatorische Vorgaben einzuhalten und Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen. jobs.title: Founding Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
The mission:

comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures, along with top European investors.

comstruct builds AI agents for construction. Our platform automates the entire flow from the bill of quantities to the fully verified invoice: RFQs and supplier matching, bid comparison and negotiation, framework contracts and orders, digital delivery notes, invoice verification and sustainability reporting. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us bring this to an industry that still runs most of it by hand.

About the role 🦺

As our Founding Customer Support Engineer you own what happens after go-live: you keep our customers' integrations running and their teams using comstruct every day.

When a delivery note doesn't map to the right project, a 3-way match fails, or data stops flowing from a customer's SAP, you own the problem end to end. You dig into logs, APIs, and data flows to find the root cause, prepare and ship smaller pull requests yourself, and work closely with engineering on more complex fixes. When you're not deep in a technical problem, you're on calls with customers, making sure the teams that went live keep using comstruct in their daily work.

You're the person the customer calls when something breaks and the one who makes sure it doesn't break again. Inside comstruct you're the voice of the customer: you spot the feature gaps that surface in real use and prioritize with the Product Engineering team which ones get built.

The deeper you get into how the product works and where it falls short, the more the door opens to move into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and ship those fixes and features yourself.

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Own inquiries end-to-end: Our customers run some of the largest construction sites in Europe. When something breaks, it's real: trucks, deliveries, invoices, deadlines.

  • Automate support with our own agents: We sell AI agents; support is a function where we also deploy them internally. You'll work out which parts of the flow an agent can handle and where the human touch still wins.

  • Ship the fix when it's yours to ship: Small PRs, config and mapping changes, data repair scripts, clearer error handling. Reviewed by engineering, shipped by you.

  • Kill recurring issues: Every ticket is a data point. You spot the patterns, bring them to Product Engineering with evidence, and push for the change that makes that ticket class disappear.

  • Build the support foundation: Playbook, macros, help center, internal runbooks. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll write the first version of it as you learn, with the founders and engineering behind you.

  • Report what matters: Time to first response, time to resolution on integration breaks, and how many recurring issue classes you eliminated. You consistently share where we stand with Customer Value Engineers and the wider team.

What we’re looking for ✨

  • 1 - 2 years in a technical, customer-facing role: Customer Success or Support Engineer, Solution Engineer, Implementation, TAM or similar.

  • You're comfortable in APIs, logs, SQL and data flows and can debug across systems you didn't build. You know when an issue is the integration, the data or the product.

  • You can explain a failed integration to an engineer and to a non-technical customer stakeholder, and both walk away clear.

  • You want to understand how the product works under the hood instead of treating it as a black box.

  • You are willing to work five days a week from our Munich office with occasional customer travel.

  • You are native in German and fluent in English.

Nice to have: Ideally, you have initial experience with Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch.

What we offer

  • A path into building: This role is a launchpad. As you learn how customers use the product and where it breaks, you can grow into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and build the fixes and features yourself.

  • Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan.

  • Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CTO Dominik Brosch, plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC.

  • Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware.

  • Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company.

  • Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca, Italy and Portugal.

jobs.description:
Clariness is looking for a Senior Business Development Director (f/md/) based in Germany, UK, US, Serbia, South Africa.

- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

Clariness helps patients access clinical trials faster through our ClinLife® platform, active in 50+ countries. In this role, you will turn expertise into real-world impact, connecting patients with studies and accelerating medical breakthroughs. Make your next role matter - help more patients join life-changing studies.

As a Senior Business Development Director, you would be responsible for:

  • Prospecting, developing, and closing new business opportunities within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, and CRO sectors.
  • Growing and managing strategic and existing customer accounts.
  • Building strong relationships with clients, partners, distributors, and key opinion leaders.
  • Representing the company at conferences, networking events, and client meetings.
  • Maintaining an accurate sales pipeline and providing reliable sales forecasts.
  • Supporting leadership in achieving commercial objectives and identifying opportunities to improve products, services, and processes.
  • Acting as a trusted advisor by bringing market insights and challenging existing approaches to drive continuous improvement.

We would like you to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of sales and business development experience with responsibility for achieving commercial targets.
  • Proven experience working with large pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology, CROs, or the broader life sciences industry.
  • Experience across key commercial and marketing disciplines, including communications, demand generation, and product marketing, in international markets.
  • Experience supporting or leading large-scale patient recruitment campaigns.
  • Demonstrated success in building strategic client relationships and driving business growth.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience hiring, mentoring, and developing high-performing commercial or marketing talent is an advantage.
  • Self-driven, strategic, and customer-focused with the ability to build lasting partnerships.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and mobile working.
  • Regular team events and open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

How to apply & what to expect:

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Senior Leadership Interview → Demo Day → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step.

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to .

Have we sparked your interest?

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.

jobs.title: Governmental & Public Affairs Internship/Working Student -  (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty. We are looking for an intern or working student to join our Growth team in Berlin.

Your Roadmap To make an Impact

  • Monitor and analyze political, regulatory, and security-policy developments at the national and EU level (defense, counter-drone, public procurement)

  • Prepare briefings, position papers, and background analyses for the founders and key stakeholders

  • Support the preparation of meetings, appointments, and events with representatives from politics, public administration, and defense

  • Build and maintain a stakeholder and contact database of relevant decision-makers and institutions

  • Research funding programs, tenders, and public procurement procedures (national & EU)

  • Contribute to TYTAN's external communications and positioning toward public sectors

  • Take ownership of your own projects that advance our political visibility and network


Must-haves

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, Law, Economics, Security/Defense Policy, or a related field

  • Strong interest in politics, security and defense topics, and European sovereignty

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially the ability to distill complex matters clearly and concisely

  • Analytical, structured thinking and a diligent, independent way of working

  • Business-fluent German and English, both written and spoken

  • Confident with common office software (or equivalent tools)

  • Discretion and a professional approach to handling sensitive

  • information

  • Minimum availability of 4 months, on-site in Berlin

Nice-to-haves

  • First hands-on experience in public affairs, government relations, an association, ministry, parliamentary office, think tank, consultancy, or NGO

  • Understanding of political decision-making processes at the federal and/or EU level

  • Knowledge of public procurement, defense policy, or regulatory frameworks

  • An existing network in the political or security-policy environment

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and a hands-on mentality in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Additional languages (e.g., French) are a plus

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €68/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant IFRS & HGB (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest deine Erfahrung im Accounting und in der Bilanzbuchhaltung in eine dynamische Unternehmensgruppe mit Sitz in Hamburg einbringen, mehrere Gesellschaften eigenverantwortlich betreuen und Finance Prozesse aktiv weiterentwickeln?

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Kunde ist eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe, die spezialisierte Softwareunternehmen für den öffentlichen Sektor unter einem Dach vereint. Der Fokus liegt auf zukunftsrelevanten Bereichen wie Mobilität, Energie und öffentlicher Sicherheit.

Aufgaben

Als Senior Accountant IFRS & HGB betreust du eigenverantwortlich zwei bis drei Softwaregesellschaften und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Finance Team für verlässliche Abschlüsse und skalierbare Accounting Prozesse.

  • Abschlussverantwortung: Erstellung von Monats, Quartals und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS für mehrere Gesellschaften.
  • Accounting: Steuerung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung von Hauptbuch und Anlagen bis hin zu Debitoren, Kreditoren und Kontenabstimmungen.
  • Software Bilanzierung: Abbildung spezifischer Geschäftsvorfälle rund um Softwarelizenzen, SaaS Modelle, Projektgeschäft sowie Wartungs und Supportverträge.
  • Steuern & Internationales: Erstellung von Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen sowie Bearbeitung grenzüberschreitender Sachverhalte und Unterstützung bei Jahressteuererklärungen.
  • Intercompany: Abstimmung und Verrechnung von Geschäftsvorfällen innerhalb der internationalen Unternehmensgruppe.
  • Systeme & Digitalisierung: Aktive Mitwirkung bei der Einführung von Odoo sowie bei der Automatisierung und Weiterentwicklung der Accounting Prozesse und Systemschnittstellen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Finance Teams und der Geschäftsführung sowie zentrale Ansprechperson für Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater, Banken und Betriebsprüfer.

Qualifikation

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Accounting, Rechnungswesen oder Steuern. Eine Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) ist von großem Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Mindestens 5 bis 10 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Accounting oder in der Bilanzbuchhaltung
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse nach HGB und IFRS.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Buchhaltungssoftware und gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und der Einführung neuer Systeme.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit, Genauigkeit und Hands on Mentalität sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie Motivation, sich fachlich und perspektivisch weiterzuentwickeln.

Nice to haves: Jedes zusätzliche Know how ist ein Pluspunkt

  • Erfahrung in einem Software-, IT- oder Technologieunternehmen
  • Erfahrung in der parallelen Betreuung mehrerer Gesellschaften oder Geschäftseinheiten
  • Kenntnisse im österreichischen UGB
  • Erfahrung aus Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Beratung, beispielsweise aus dem Big Four Umfeld

Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Freue dich auf ein attraktives Vergütungsmodell, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung kannst du zwei bis drei Tage pro Woche im Homeoffice arbeiten.
  • Modernes Office: Zentraler Arbeitsplatz in Hamburg mit moderner Ausstattung und sehr guter Anbindung.
  • Work Life Balance: Eine geregelte 40 Stunden Woche und 30 Urlaubstage schaffen einen verlässlichen Rahmen.
  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Durch das weitere Wachstum der Gruppe und den geplanten Aufbau gemeinsamer Finance Strukturen entstehen langfristig spannende Möglichkeiten, zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bringe deine Erfahrung aktiv beim Aufbau moderner Accounting Prozesse und bei der Implementierung neuer Systeme ein.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit dem Finance Führungsteam und den Finance Verantwortlichen der Portfoliounternehmen zusammen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Unterstützung bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.
  • Unternehmenskultur: Dich erwartet ein unternehmerisches Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.

Die Rolle als Senior Accountant IFRS & HGB klingt genau nach dir?
Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen Telefonat weitere Insights zu Unternehmen und Position.

jobs.title: System Administrator (f/m/d) - Defense Products
jobs.description:
Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen.

Als führender europäischer Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Lösungen setzen wir bei IONOS auf ein starkes Miteinander, offene Strukturen und flache Hierarchien mit agilem Teamgeist. Bei uns gehen Arbeit und Spaß Hand in Hand – in einem Umfeld, das Dir den nötigen Freiraum bietet. Da wir kontinuierlich wachsen, suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Team. Werde Teil von IONOS und wachse gemeinsam mit uns!

Du verstärkst unser hochmotiviertes Expert*innen-Team im Kampf gegen Cybersicherheitsbedrohungen. Gemeinsam mit Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) und Network Engineers planst und betreibst Du unsere modernsten Defense-Plattformen. Diese sind das Rückgrat zum Schutz unserer Hosting-Produkte und Infrastrukturen – von klassischer DDoS-Mitigation über moderne Web Application Firewalls (WAF) und Zero-Trust-Strategien bis hin zu unserem Content Delivery Network (CDN). Wir leben eine Kultur, in der kreative Ideen, agiles Arbeiten, Eigeninitiative und Mitgestaltung großgeschrieben werden.

Aufgabenbereich

  • Infrastruktur-Administration: Administration und Troubleshooting hochverfügbarer, komplexer Infrastrukturen – inklusive der Teilnahme an einer geteilten Rufbereitschaft (On-Call Rotation).
  • Plattform-Optimierung: Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung verteilter DDoS-Abwehrplattformen sowie zugehöriger Analyse- und Visualisierungsmechanismen.
  • Threat & Trend Analysis: Monitoring der Systeme, Analyse von Sicherheitsangriffen und aktives Tracking aktueller Branchen- und Security-Trends.
  • Tech-Evaluierung & Innovation: Bewertung neuer Technologien und Produkte sowie Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Features für internationale Setups.
  • DevOps & Lifecycle: Unterstützung unserer Unternehmensziele durch eine effiziente Betriebsarchitektur, aktives Lifecycle-Management und schlanke Prozesse in einer agilen DevOps-Umgebung.
  • CI/CD Automation: Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD-Pipelines und unterstützenden technischen Prozessen

Qualifikationen

  • Fundament: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. Berufsausbildung.
  • Linux & Security Passion: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration komplexer, verteilter Linux-Systeme sowie ein starkes Interesse an Cybersecurity und fundierte Netzwerkkenntnisse.
  • Reverse Proxy & WAF: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und dem Betrieb von Nginx als Reverse Proxy oder Web Application Firewall.
  • Routing Expertise: Hands-on-Erfahrung bei der Implementierung von BGP, Flowspec und Anycast-Routing auf Linux-Systemen und Netzwerk-Routern.
  • Automation Mindset: Leidenschaft für Automation mit Tools wie Ansible, Puppet und Python, um manuelle, repetitive Aufgaben konsequent zu eliminieren.
  • Analytische Schärfe: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten zur Bewertung von DDoS-Attacken, Umsetzung wirksamer Gegenmaßnahmen und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Defense-Plattformen.
  • Tech-Stack (Bonus): Erste Erfahrungen mit Technologien wie Docker, Kubernetes, ClickHouse oder dem ELK-Stack sind ein Plus.
  • Open Source Spirit: Du teilst unsere Begeisterung für Open-Source-Technologien, insbesondere Linux.
  • Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus).

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Über IONOS

IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Cloud / Data Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wer ist synvert a GlobalLogic company?

synvert, ein Unternehmen der GlobalLogic, ist ein innovatives Beratungsunternehmen mit über 550 Consultants, spezialisiert auf Daten & KI. Mit mehr als 30 Jahren Erfahrung hat synvert über 3.000 erfolgreiche Projekte für mehr als 250 Kunden in der EMEA-Region realisiert und steht für langfristige partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Kunden. 


About Us

synvert bietet maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen durch den gezielten Einsatz von Cloud-Technologien, Datenstrategien und KI-Implementierungen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner verbindet synvert technologische Exzellenz mit tiefem Branchenverständnis und unterstützt ihre Kunden bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung datengetriebener Entscheidungen.  


Deine Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für die Analyse, Architektur, Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Cloud- und Data-Plattformen für namhafte Kunden aus unterschiedlichen Branchen
  • Technische Führung bei der Entwicklung moderner Cloud-, Hybrid- und On-Premises-Lösungen für analytische Systeme
  • Design und Implementierung skalierbarer Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Lakehouses sowie moderner Datenarchitekturen
  • Beratung unserer Kunden bei Cloud-Strategien, Architekturentscheidungen und Technologieauswahl
  • Planung und Durchführung anspruchsvoller Cloud-Migrationen sowie Modernisierung bestehender Datenplattformen
  • Entwicklung von Proof of Concepts, Referenzarchitekturen und Best Practices für innovative Technologien
  • Technische Leitung von Projekten bzw. Teilprojekten sowie Verantwortung für Architektur- und Qualitätsstandards
  • Mentoring und Coaching von Consultants und Engineers sowie Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams
  • Durchführung von Workshops, Architektur-Reviews und technischen Präsentationen auf Kundenebene
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres Leistungsportfolios sowie Unterstützung bei Presales-Aktivitäten und Angebotsprozessen


Was erwarten wir von Dir?

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in einem MINT-Fach oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre (Senior) bzw. 8+ Jahre (Principal) praktische Erfahrung im Cloud- und Data Engineering oder in der Architektur moderner Datenplattformen
  • Fundierte Projekterfahrung mit mindestens einer führenden Cloud-Plattform wie Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, AWS oder Google Cloud sowie Technologien wie Snowflake, Databricks oder vergleichbaren Lösungen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse moderner Datenarchitekturen (Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, Data Lake, Data Mesh) und entsprechender Best Practices
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform), CI/CD, DevOps sowie automatisierten Deployment-Prozessen

jobs.title: Move to New Zealand - Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company.
 
We welcome applications from individuals located internationally looking to relocate to Auckland, New Zealand. This role is based in Auckland and requires in-office attendance (hybrid). 
 
Propellerhead hires exceptional talent from all around the globe and many of our people have relocated to New Zealand to join our team. We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country.
 
Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details).
 
 

The Role:
Propellerhead is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our core engineering team (reporting to the CTO) to research and define future technical strategies for Propellerhead and our clients. The engineering team provides the core tools, techniques, and software libraries to support service development teams.

You will guide proofs of concept to production, mentoring team members on new technologies and practices. You’ll also help our teams and customers navigate the development of effective, secure enterprise software and deployment architectures in the age of AI.

Your team will consist of like-minded software craftspeople and will operate with a degree of autonomy seldom experienced in other organisations.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

If you are ready to work on real problems with real impact, and help lay the groundwork for what comes next - we would like to hear from you.


Role Responsibilities:
  • Define technical solutions through research and team investigation, in line with the vision directed by the CTO.
  • Actively participate in the design and construction of software across the full stack - including code structure, deployment architecture, DevOps, automated testing, and integration of third-party systems. This will primarily involve the use of LLMs, with the expectation you will do virtually no hand-coding.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders and fellow Propellerhead team members to ensure a shared understanding of solution design and roadmap delivery in line with agreed budgets.
  • Drive the migration of existing polyglot solutions to standardized Rust and TypeScript, towards more standardized and portable deployment architectures, and pass on technical learning to the broader organisation to embed the technical strategies throughout.

    • Skills and Experience Required:
  • 7+ years experience as a Software Developer or Engineer, including experience working with enterprise-level complexity.
  • High proficiency in at least one enterprise-quality programming language and its ecosystem. For example, C# .NET or Java and Spring.
  • Must have some experience with a lower-level language for application or systems development such as Rust (preferable) or C++. 
  • Experience in TypeScript and React or similar front-end frameworks, and a well-developed understanding of web application development.
  • Hands-on experience deploying to Azure and/or AWS, including building CI/CD pipelines and using infrastructure scripting frameworks (e.g., Terraform).
  • Demonstrable experience in software design for distributed and asynchronous architecture. In particular, you will need to show examples of projects using microservices and messaging where you have been a key contributor to the design and construction.
  • You will already have embraced the use of LLMs over hand-coding and be able to articulate how this has improved the speed to deliver and safety of the systems you build.
  • With the help of LLMs you can produce clear and concise design documents.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills to translate between requirements and technical tasks.

    • About Propellerhead:

    Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

    How We Build Software:

    We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

    Benefits:

    • Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration.

    • Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients.

    • Opportunity for professional growth and development.

    • Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.

    • Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.

    • This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model).

    • Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination.

     

    Cover Letter:

    *Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed.

    It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value.

    At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients.

    In recruitment, however, AI isn’t used to assess skills, experience or suitability for a role. Every application is reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair, engaged and thoughtfully human process.

    Therefore we kindly ask that you refrain from using it in your application. We're excited to learn about your unique experiences and ideas, so please apply as your authentic self!

Senior Go Backend Developer (Demand Intergrations) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Running the Engine Behind 200M+ Daily Ad Decisions

Behind every ad decision at adjoe is a system designed to operate at massive scale, serving more than 770 million mobile users every year. The Demand API Integrations team owns the systems that connect our platform to the global adtech ecosystem, handling over 5.5 billion API requests daily across installs, events, views, clicks, and postbacks from Mobile Measurement Partners.

We operate a dedicated A/B testing environment against live traffic to validate system behavior under real-world conditions, allowing us to evaluate advertiser integrations, benchmark partner performance, and verify attribution accuracy end-to-end before deploying globally.

We integrate TensorFlow-based ML models to predict user engagement and purchase likelihood, directly influencing real-time ad distribution. To meet our strict 100ms latency constraint, we prioritize efficient model serving, low-latency data access, and deliberate system design.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years in Go, built for scale. You have 3+ years building production Go services and know how to profile and optimize applications under real traffic, not just identify bottlenecks, but eliminate them. You've worked on large Go applications with considerable daily request volume.

  • Distributed systems are your default context. You design and operate microservice architectures using Kafka and SQS/SNS for reliable asynchronous communication, and are responsible for collecting and aggregating billions of daily API events into Kafka streams queryable from the data lake in seconds.

  • Data performance matters at every layer. You work with Druid, MySQL, Redis, and DynamoDB, optimizing queries and data access patterns to deliver few-millisecond response times. You know the tradeoffs between different storage solutions and when each one is the right tool.

  • Bridge product and Data Science. You collaborate directly with Data Scientists to integrate ML algorithms that optimize ad delivery: translating complex mathematical solutions into production-ready backend services.

  • Partner-facing data ownership. You support partners through well-documented open APIs, providing raw or aggregated data transparently based on their business needs.

  • Infrastructure fluency is part of the job. You have hands-on experience with Terraform, Docker, and serverless infrastructure, owning services end-to-end from development to production.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.
