jobs.title: Senior Risk Management Specialist (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As Senior Risk Management Specialist, you will help scale and further develop lemon.markets’ Risk Management Framework in a period of growing regulatory expectations, business complexity, and organisational maturity. Sitting within the Risk team and working closely with the Head of Risk, you will take over meaningful responsibilities across multiple risk domains and help ensure our controls, assessments, and governance evolve with the company. Over the next 6 to 12 months, your focus will be on strengthening risk processes across operational and non-financial risk topics, contributing to financial risk topics such as ICAAP and ILAAP, and improving the structure, transparency, and efficiency of our risk tooling and reporting. This role matters because strong, pragmatic risk management is a core enabler of scalable growth in a regulated Brokerage-as-a-Service business. You will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to turn regulatory and risk requirements into practical, tech-enabled solutions that reduce manual work and improve decision-making. It is a strong opportunity for someone who combines broad risk knowledge with a hands-on mindset and wants to help build a mature framework in a fast-moving environment.

In this role you will:

  • Own the identification, assessment, and documentation of risks across key domains together with the Risk team, business stakeholders, and control owners, so lemon.markets can make informed decisions and maintain a resilient risk profile as the business grows.

  • Drive risk assessments, control testing, and issue remediation tracking with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance, so we can detect weaknesses early, strengthen controls, and follow through on corrective actions.

  • Maintain and improve our internal control framework, risk register, and operational risk procedures in close collaboration with the Head of Risk and cross-functional stakeholders, so our framework remains effective, usable, and aligned with business and regulatory needs.

  • Contribute to risk topics across operational and non-financial risk, financial risk, ICAAP, ILAAP, third-party risk, and security-related assessments, so we can build a broader and more integrated view of risk across the organisation.

  • Draft clear business and technical requirements for process improvements, tooling enhancements, and automation initiatives with Product, Engineering, and Operations, so we can increase risk transparency, improve reporting quality, and reduce manual work.

  • Collaborate with auditors, supervisory stakeholders, and internal teams on evidence gathering, incident analysis, root-cause identification, and follow-up actions, so lemon.markets stays audit-ready and continues to improve the effectiveness of its risk management practices.


You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • You bring strong hands-on experience in Risk Management within FinTech, banking, audit, consulting, or a similarly regulated environment, with broad exposure across multiple risk domains.

  • You have solid knowledge of operational and non-financial risk, internal controls, risk governance, and risk assessments, plus a good understanding of financial risk topics such as credit, market, liquidity, ICAAP, and ILAAP.

  • You are familiar with the relevant regulatory foundations, including MaRisk, DORA, CRR, IFR, and applicable EBA and ESMA guidelines; knowledge of MiFID, MaComp, and WpHG is a strong plus.

  • You are confident working with risk management tools, structured documentation, reporting, testing, and validation, and you are comfortable translating requirements into pragmatic process or tooling improvements.

  • You communicate clearly in English, and you ideally bring professional working proficiency in German to navigate regulatory documents and stakeholder communication in a German market context.

  • You are hands-on, analytical, and collaborative: you enjoy building, improving, and following through, work well across functions, and stay effective in fast-moving or sometimes ambiguous environments.


How we take care of you

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more and leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites, or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations, as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. We partner with industry leaders such SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

What You'll Do:

As a Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer at Sierra, and a founding member of this function, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments, while helping define how Sierra’s AI platform is deployed and operated across enterprise environments. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to architect, deploy, upgrade, and manage Sierra's AI platform infrastructure — ensuring every deployment meets their security, compliance, and operational requirements. In addition, you’ll establish the standards, tooling, and processes that make deployments scalable and repeatable, and partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. This role will define how Sierra scales some of its most complex customer engagements.

  • Own deployment architecture conversations and execution — designing and implementing deployment strategies across customer environments, including VPC configuration, permissioning, networking, and infrastructure provisioning.

  • Manage the full infrastructure lifecycle for some of Sierra’s most critical customers: initial deployment, ongoing upgrades, scaling, and incident support.

  • Develop and maintain deployment runbooks, upgrade procedures, and automation tooling to make operations repeatable and reliable.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure Sierra's platform is deployable and operable across diverse customer requirements.

  • Track record of managing deployments in customer-owned cloud environments, including navigating security reviews, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Strong operational instincts: you think about upgrades, rollbacks, monitoring, and failure modes from the start, not as an afterthought.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and collaborating across engineering, product, and go-to-market teams.

Even better...

We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

jobs.title: Senior Leader - Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

About the role

Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.

We're hiring a Senior Leader of Product Marketing, reporting to the CPTO, to own the positioning, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market orchestration that makes that story credible to buyers who've heard "AI transformation" pitches before and have learned to discount them. This is a strategic leadership and launch-execution role: you're accountable for a narrative that has to survive a skeptical CTO's follow-up questions, not just land in a pitch deck.

You'll sit at the center of Product, Engineering, Sales, CS, and executive leadership — turning hard technical work into a case buyers trust, giving Sales what they need to win the deals that matter, and grounding pricing and roadmap decisions in real market evidence.

Growth today comes primarily through our sales motion — there isn't yet a significant inbound or demand-generation engine to lean on. This role needs to work effectively within that reality now, while helping shape what comes next, rather than assuming a demand-gen infrastructure that doesn't currently exist.

What you'll own

Positioning & narrative

  • Define and defend the category narrative and product positioning — including translating technical/AI capabilities into value claims that hold up under scrutiny from technical buyers, procurement, and security review, without overclaiming

  • Own messaging architecture across product lines and keep it consistent as the portfolio grows

Market & competitive intelligence

  • Run competitive intelligence (win-loss analysis, competitor tracking, technical benchmarking) and be the most credible voice in the room on what the market actually believes — evidence, not anecdote

  • Feed that signal directly into product roadmap and pricing decisions

  • Build lightweight, repeatable, automatable processes to get customer voice and insight directly into product development and launches — this currently happens ad hoc and needs an owner

GTM orchestration

  • Own launch strategy and sequencing — what to launch, when, and how big a moment to make of it — partnering with Product on roadmap-to-revenue sequencing so GTM readiness isn't an afterthought

  • Define launch success metrics and report on them credibly to executive leadership

  • Champion and put structure around the shift toward faster product launches — building quickly and iterating based on real performance

Sales & CS enablement

  • Equip Sales to win deals with best-in-class sales collateral, tools, and enablement, and support strategic deals directly where positioning or competitive dynamics are the blocker

  • Own strategic decisions on positioning, enablement, and the go-to-market motion for Sales leadership, not just content delivery

Pricing & packaging

  • Provide evidence-based input on pricing and packaging based on willingness-to-pay, competitive dynamics, and customer research, partnering with Product and Finance on monetization for new capabilities

Team & function leadership

  • Build, hire, and develop a product marketing team, and set the operating rhythm and tools for the function, including how AI is used to raise team velocity and rigor (currently a team of 4 product marketers)

  • Represent product marketing in executive/board-level conversations on market position and competitive dynamics

  • Operate as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership without formal authority over them — comfortable creating healthy tension, pushing back, and holding a different set of priorities from those teams when it's the right call

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in product marketing, including 2+ years in people leadership, with a track record owning positioning and GTM strategy for complex technical B2B/B2B2C products — enterprise SaaS and/or AI/ML strongly preferred

  • Confident working alongside engineering and product: able to hold your own technically and translate real product/technical complexity into buyer value and revenue opportunity without a translator in the room

  • Strong quantitative instincts, with proven partnership across Product/tech, Sales, and Finance on roadmap, deal strategy, and monetisation — project-managing end-to-end what's built, what's sold, and revenue recognised

  • Executive presence: has presented market/competitive strategy to C-suite or board audiences

  • Proven experience operating at genuine scale-up pace — building processes, structure, and infrastructure from scratch with a lean team, rather than inheriting the mature systems and support functions (UXR, demand-gen, established pricing models) that exist at larger, more established organisations

  • You are an innovator and experimenter looking for new trends and technology to scale the impact and abilities of your team

  • You are comfortable with and motivated by high-expectations stakeholders; you are able to earn trust and retain it through difficult situations

  • You have a positive-sum mentality - you're equally excited about both rolling up your sleeves to get something done and reflecting on the bigger picture

  • You have high internal expectations for what is possible and the ability to bring others along on that journey

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in your own workflow (competitive research, content drafting, win-loss synthesis) — this is now a baseline expectation, not a bonus

Nice to have

  • Experience at a company that scaled through a comparable stage transition (e.g., Series B→E, or pre-IPO→public)


Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

jobs.title: Werkstudent IT-Administration & Security (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Intro

Auf einen Blick

  • Rolle: Werkstudent IT-Administration & Security / Werkstudent IT Support (m/w/d)

  • Unternehmen: Vivira, Digital Health, Anbieter der ersten dauerhaft gelisteten DiGA Deutschlands

  • Standort: Berlin-Mitte (Mindspace Stadtmitte), hybrid

  • Stunden: 20 Stunden/Woche im Semester, flexibel rund um Deine Vorlesungen und Prüfungen

  • Start: Ab sofort

  • Vergütung: 16–20 €/Stunde, je nach Erfahrung

  • Sprachen: Englisch fließend, Deutsch mindestens B1

  • Voraussetzung: Immatrikulierte/r Student/in

  • Perspektive: Echte Verantwortung, Mentoring und ein realistischer Weg in eine Festanstellung nach dem Abschluss


Hilf mit, das IT-Rückgrat eines der führenden Digital-Health-Unternehmen Deutschlands aufzubauen.


Bei Vivira machst Du weit mehr, als Passwörter zurückzusetzen oder Laptops einzurichten. Als Werkstudent im Bereich IT & Security sorgst Du mit dafür, dass ein schnell wachsendes Digital-Health-Unternehmen in Berlin jeden Tag reibungslos läuft: vom Onboarding neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen über die Verwaltung moderner SaaS-Anwendungen bis zur Unterstützung unserer Security-Infrastruktur.


Du arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einer modernen, cloudbasierten Umgebung und trägst zu einer Technologie bei, die Tausenden von Patientinnen und Patienten hilft, ihre Rückenschmerzen in den Griff zu bekommen, mit Deutschlands erster dauerhaft erstattungsfähiger Digitaler Gesundheitsanwendung (DiGA).


Wenn Du Informatik (oder ein verwandtes Fach) studierst und echte Praxiserfahrung in IT & Security sammeln willst statt nur eines Praktikumstitels, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen

  • IT-Helpdesk & Technischer Support: Du unterstützt den Vivira IT-Helpdesk und leistest remote sowie vor Ort First-Level-Support bei Software, Tools und allgemeinem Troubleshooting.

  • Infrastruktur vor Ort: Manche Aufgaben lassen sich remote erledigen, regelmäßig bist Du aber in unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte, um bei IT-Hardware und Security-Infrastruktur tatkräftig anzupacken.

  • On- & Offboarding: Du unterstützt das IT-On- und Offboarding, von der physischen Einrichtung des Offices über die Vorbereitung der Hardware für neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen bis zur Rücknahme bei ausscheidenden.

  • SaaS-Administration: Du hilfst bei der Verwaltung verschiedener SaaS-Anwendungen, Benutzerkonten und Zugriffsrechte.

  • Hardware-Wartung: Du kümmerst Dich mit um Reparaturen und Austausch von Geräten, damit unser Team immer gut ausgestattet ist.

  • Netzwerk-Infrastruktur: Du unterstützt das Monitoring unserer Netzwerk-Infrastruktur, inklusive Firewalls, Routern und VPN-Lösungen.

  • Dokumentation: Du hilfst dabei, Systemkonfigurationen, Richtlinien und Prozesse aktuell zu halten.

  • IT-Security: Du unterstützt Security-Initiativen wie Access Management, Endpoint Security, MFA und Device Compliance.


Das lernst Du bei uns

Praxiserfahrung, über die die meisten Studierenden nur in Vorlesungen lesen:

  • Moderne Apple-/macOS-Administration & Endpoint Management (MDM)

  • Cloudbasierte IT-Infrastruktur und SaaS-Administration

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Grundlagen der IT-Security

  • Device Lifecycle Management

  • IT-Betrieb in einem regulierten Digital-Health-Umfeld

  • Support für verteilte, remote-first arbeitende Teams

Du arbeitest mit einem modernen, cloud-first Toolset, darunter MDM für unsere Apple-Flotte, Single Sign-on und IAM, eine führende Productivity Suite sowie aktuelle Endpoint-Security- und Netzwerk-Lösungen. Den kompletten Stack stellen wir Dir im ersten Gespräch vor.


Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Du bist aktuell in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem anderen technischen Studiengang an einer Hochschule in Berlin oder Umgebung immatrikuliert.

  • Du kannst regelmäßig aus unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte arbeiten, mitten im Zentrum von Berlin.

  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis von macOS und Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen.

  • Du interessierst Dich für IT-Administration, Infrastruktur und Informationssicherheit.

  • Du hilfst gerne und kommunizierst freundlich und serviceorientiert.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und proaktiv.

  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch und hast mindestens Deutschkenntnisse auf B1-Niveau, da Du regelmäßig Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort unterstützt.

  • Erste Erfahrung durch eigene Projekte, Praktika oder Studentenjobs (Werkstudent, HiWi, IT-Support) ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.


Das erwartet Dich bei Vivira

  • Vergütung: 16–20 € pro Stunde, je nach Erfahrung, für eine 20-Stunden-Werkstudentenstelle, die sich an Dein Studium anpasst.

  • Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Deinem Vorlesungsplan und Deinen Prüfungsphasen richten.

  • Arbeitsplatz: Arbeite von Zuhause oder aus unserem Berliner HQ in zentraler Lage (Mindspace Stadtmitte), mit hochwertiger Apple-Hardware.

  • Recharge: Bezahlte Urlaubstage für echte Pausen und neue Energie.

  • Gesundheit: Beweglichkeit und Rückenpower direkt von uns für Dich, mit digitaler Unterstützung, die Du selbst nutzen kannst.

  • Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Vorteilen für Shopping, Technik & mehr.

  • Empfehlungsprämie: Netzwerk teilen lohnt sich. Jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung wird belohnt.

  • Highlights: Mehrere Company- und Team-Events pro Jahr sorgen für Austausch, Spaß und ein echtes Wir-Gefühl.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Ownership ab Tag eins, flache Hierarchien und erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich Zeit für Dein Mentoring nehmen.

  • Echte Perspektive: Leistungsstarke Werkstudierende werden regelmäßig für Festanstellungen nach dem Abschluss berücksichtigt.


Gut zu wissen

  • Wie viele Stunden pro Woche? 20 Stunden im Semester, flexibel rund um Dein Studium geplant.

  • Wo ist der Job? In Berlin-Mitte im Mindspace Stadtmitte, mit hybridem Setup: Du arbeitest teils vor Ort, teils remote.

  • Muss ich Deutsch sprechen? Deutsch auf B1-Niveau reicht aus; unsere Arbeitssprache ist Englisch.

  • Brauche ich Berufserfahrung? Nein. Echtes Interesse an IT-Administration und Security plus solide macOS-Kenntnisse sind das, was zählt.

  • Kann daraus ein Vollzeitjob werden? Ja. Leistungsstarke Werkstudierende erhalten regelmäßig Festanstellungsangebote nach dem Abschluss.


Über Vivira


ViViRA. Simply move.


Vivira entwickelt digitale Gesundheitsversorgung mit echtem Impact. Unsere App ist Deutschlands erste dauerhaft gelistete Digitale Gesundheitsanwendung (DiGA) gegen Rückenschmerzen und offiziell im BfArM-Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger Anwendungen gelistet. Jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt in Deutschland kann Vivira verordnen, die Kosten übernimmt vollständig die gesetzliche Krankenversicherung.


Wir sind ein internationales, schnell wachsendes Team mit Sitz in Berlin, vereint durch den Anspruch, Gesundheitsversorgung zugänglicher, wirksamer und menschlicher zu machen.


So bewirbst Du Dich


Schick uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei Dir. Der Prozess ist kurz: ein Kennenlern-Call, ein praxisnahes Gespräch mit dem Team und dann die Entscheidung.


Bewirb Dich jetzt und hilf mit, die IT am Laufen zu halten, die digitale Gesundheitsversorgung möglich macht.

jobs.title: Avionics Software Engineer
Growth Lead (GTM/B2B)
jobs.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The role

Dex's candidate side runs on an AI agent. The client side, how companies find us, become clients, and hire through us, still runs on people and effort. It works today. As we grow, it needs a system behind it. That's what you'll build.

You'll be our first dedicated B2B GTM hire, and you'll build the system that runs the client side of the business: the sales pipeline, the CRM, the automations, the client-management engine. Your founder and team handle the relationships and the close; you’ll give them the machine that makes every one of those relationships successful.

This is a rare kind of role for someone a few years into their career: part operator, part builder, part architect of a commercial engine that doesn't exist yet.

You'll build it AI-first, the same way we build everything at Dex. Dex is an AI-native company — we build with AI, we run on AI, and the machine you build should have it in its bones.

This is a strong fit if you're a few years into your career and already the person who builds the systems everyone else works in.

We're still learning exactly where the early priorities sit, so some of this will sharpen over your first few months. The core of it stays the same: turning effort into systems.

You'll grow this role as Dex grows, and as you prove out what it needs, you'll shape what comes next.

What you'll build

The sales pipeline, operationalised

  • Own the mechanics of every deal from first conversation to signed client and live roles: stages, owners, next steps, handoffs

  • Build the qualification, follow-up and deal-support workflows — pitch materials, proposals and case studies ready before they're asked for — so nothing slips and no deal stalls for want of admin

  • Own the pipeline data — conversion by stage, deal velocity, forecasts — so the weekly numbers are trusted and decisions get faster

The CRM and client engine

  • Make the CRM the single source of truth for every company, contact, deal and role — nothing lives in anyone's head

  • Build repeatable onboarding for new clients and account-management rhythms for live ones

  • Create the plays for expansion and repeat roles, and the feedback loops that get client insight back into the product

Automation and AI, everywhere

  • Anything done twice gets a workflow. Follow-ups, onboarding steps, meeting prep, proposals, reporting — automate it

  • We're an AI company and we expect you to work like one: LLMs and agents are your default tools, not an experiment

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • Every client, contact and deal lives in the CRM with a stage, an owner and a next step — the pipeline is legible at a glance

  • Every live deal has a clear next step and nothing slips — follow-ups, proposals and pitch materials go out the day they're needed, because the machine drafts them

  • New-client onboarding is a playbook measured in days, not an improvised scramble

  • The team's client-facing time goes on pitching, closing and relationships — not admin

  • We know our client-side numbers cold: conversion by stage, by channel, by segment — and where the machine needs upgrading next

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think and operate than perfect experience. You will likely be someone who:

  • Has 2–4 years operating in or around B2B revenue in an early-stage startup environment (Seed–Series B) - in growth, sales ops, revops or a founder's-associate-style role

  • Thinks in systems: you see a task done twice and itch to automate it; you build process where it helps and kill it where it doesn't

  • Is technical enough to build without waiting for permission — you can make a serious CRM do real work, wire tools together with APIs and webhooks, and turn messy data into something trustworthy; SQL fluency is a real plus

  • Has revenue or ops systems you've built before, with results you can point to

  • Is commercially sharp — you optimise for signed clients and filled roles, not pretty dashboards

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally; a lot of B2B growth is writing

  • Takes initiative, brings order to ambiguity

  • Is AI native: you already use LLMs and agents to do a week's work in a day

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

 

Practical details

  • Right to work in the UK is required

  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship

 

If the above sounds like you and you want to work at the centre of a fast-moving startup, we’d love to hear from you! Applying will take you to our careers page, where you can apply directly.


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

Your Mission at plancraft

We're building plancraft towards an agentic-first product experience. That means AI-enabled capabilities our customers actually use: features that take real administrative work off a tradesperson's plate and hold up under production load, day after day.

Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers.

This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems.

We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build.

Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate.

Your Responsibilities

  • AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo.

  • The wider technical system. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you'll shape architectural direction and the properties that should hold across teams, while enabling individual teams to build and ship independently.

  • Data foundations for AI-enabled workflows. You’ll help turn product and business data into meaningful signals, insights, and context that AI can use reliably in customer-facing workflows — from defining the right data models and semantics, and drawing a clear line between operational data and knowledge, to making that understanding available where it creates real product value.

  • How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation.

How you'll work & influence

We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets.

You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start:

  • Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions.

  • Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in.

  • Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team.

  • Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count.

Your Profile

  • Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership.

  • Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine.

  • Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one.

  • Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about.

  • Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes.

  • Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively.

  • A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area.

  • C1 English. German is a plus, not a must.

Prior experience building AI or ML capabilities is a huge plus — including work from before the LLM era — but it's not a fixed requirement. Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction.

You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)

DAS MACHT DICH AUS

Deine Qualifikationen als Senior Performance Marketing Manager

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Performance Marketing im D2C Umfeld, davon nachweislich mit internationaler Marktverantwortung
  • Ausgeprägtes Creative-Verständnis: Du kannst kreative Konzepte briefen, bewerten und weiterentwickeln

Wir sind ein bisschen anders – und genau das macht uns aus:

  • Innovation – Wir denken lieber „Warum eigentlich nicht?“ statt „Das war schon immer so.“ Wir lieben neue Ideen, unkonventionelle Wege – und bleiben nie stehen.


(WH)yfood?

  • Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven. Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
  • Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen. Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
  • Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.


KONTAKT

Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience

 

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

 

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

 

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

 

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

 

Here's what you can expect to be working on

  • Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

  • Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

  • Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

  • Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

 

You should apply if:

  • You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

  • You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

  • You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

  • You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

  • You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

 

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

  • You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

  • You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

 

A bit about you

  • AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

  • Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

  • Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

  • Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

  • Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

  • Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

  • Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

 

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

 

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

 

Salary

We're not publishing a fixed band for this one. We'll build the package around your experience and the scope you bring, so please apply and let's have the conversation.

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. Für die Zukunft eines Familienunternehmens.

Mit rund 65 Mitarbeitern entwickelt und produziert das Unternehmen hochwertige Lösungen in den Bereichen Maschinenbau, Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau.

Die Auftragslage ist solide, das Unternehmen arbeitet vollständig eigenfinanziert und verfügt über eine starke Marktposition.

Ein Unternehmen. Drei Geschäftsbereiche. Eine Verantwortung. Im Zuge eines Generationenübergangs suchen wir nun eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit als Geschäftsführer (m/w/d), die das Unternehmen operativ führt und gemeinsam mit den Gesellschaftern dessen Zukunft gestaltet.

Aufgaben

Qualifikation

Sie sind Generalist, fühlen sich sowohl im technischen Umfeld als auch bei kaufmännischen Fragestellungen wohl und können je nach Situation problemlos zwischen beiden Welten wechseln.

Idealerweise verfügen Sie über:

Wichtiger als Ihr konkreter Ausbildungshintergrund ist uns Ihre Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Unternehmensbereiche miteinander zu verbinden und ganzheitlich Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Benefits

Diese Aufgabe bietet Ihnen außergewöhnliche Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten.

Sie übernehmen ein wirtschaftlich gesundes Unternehmen mit hervorragender Marktposition und hoher technischer Kompetenz von den bisher geschäftsführend tätigen Gesellschaftern.

Dabei erwartet Sie keineswegs eine restrukturierungsbedürftige Einheit, sondern die Chance, gemeinsam mit den Gesellschaftern den nächsten Entwicklungsschritt einzuleiten.

Sie erhalten den Freiraum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln und Ihren persönlichen Fingerabdruck im Unternehmen zu hinterlassen.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are looking to hire a Deal Desk Analyst to support Harvey AI’s growing global sales organization. This is a hybrid role which combines quote-to-cash execution and deal structure and pricing strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, and Legal to ensure deals are accurately priced, structured, approved, and closed.

Roughly half this role is deal execution (order ops, SFDC hygiene, queue management) and half is deal strategy (pricing analysis, deal structuring, customer-facing collateral).

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys being close to the deal flow, solving process issues in real time, and helping scale systems and workflows as the business grows.

What You'll Do

  • Deal Operations

    • Review, validate, and process customer orders to ensure accuracy, compliance with pricing and contracting policies, and readiness for booking and billing

    • Support Sales reps with Salesforce (SFDC) opportunity management, quoting workflows, and deal hygiene

    • Manage and triage a Deal Operations ticketing queue, ensuring timely responses and clear communication with stakeholders

    • Partner with Deal Desk to support pricing approvals, contract structures, and deal execution logistics

    • Act as a frontline support resource for SFDC and CPQ-related questions from Sales

    • Assist with CRM and CPQ enhancement on an ad hoc basis, including:

      • gathering and drafting business requirements

      • supporting user acceptance testing (UAT) and QA

      • helping roll out new workflows, fields, or guardrails

  • Deal Strategy

    • Assist with structuring, pricing, and negotiating complex deals side-by-side with GTM account teams

    • Build scenario-based pricing models (usage projections, ARR impact, credit allotment sizing) to support deal structuring and executive approvals.

    • Leverage product telemetry (feature use, token usage)

    • Summarize and escalate deal approvals through leadership chains

  • Contribute to sales and deal desk enablement, including documentation, process guides, and training support

  • Identify recurring issues or inefficiencies in overall process and straegy and surface recommendations for improvement


What You Have

  • 2-4+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or in a financial analytical capacity

  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with complex deal structures

  • Ability to communicate clearly with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations stakeholders

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes are still being defined

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce (SFDC) as a CRM, including opportunity and quoting workflows

  • Exposure to CPQ tools (e.g., Salesforce CPQ, DealHub, Ironclad CLM, or similar), with a basic understanding of how pricing and approvals are operationalized

  • Experience managing or working within a ticketing or queue-based support model (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce cases, or similar)

  • Prior involvement in CRM/CPQ projects or enhancements, such as documenting requirements, participating in testing, or supporting system rollouts

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to build pricing models and scenario analyses from scratch

  • Aptitude and skillset for leveraging AI tools to help drive efficiencies for the internal Deal Desk team and GTM stakeholders

  • Familiarity with consumption or usage-based pricing models is a plus
